Name: Joel, Son of Pedaiah
Summary: Son of Pedaiah, ruler of the half tribe of Manasseh.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:20: Son of Pedaiah, ruler of the half tribe of Manasseh.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Joel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
